description: This file defines the DeploymentBasedQueueBalancer class, which implements a stream queue balancer that uses deployment and silo status information to distribute queues among silos in an Orleans cluster. It manages silo states, initializes queue distribution, and responds to cluster membership changes.

classes.name: DeploymentBasedQueueBalancer
classes.description: A queue balancer that uses deployment configuration and silo status to distribute queues among silos, balancing load based on resource availability.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Factory method to create an instance of DeploymentBasedQueueBalancer using dependency injection.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the queue balancer with a queue mapper and sets up internal state.

methods.name: NotifyAfterStart
methods.description: Delays for a specified period to mark the silo as mature and then notifies listeners.

methods.name: RecordImmatureSilo
methods.description: Marks a silo as immature, waits for the maturity period, then marks it as mature.

methods.name: GetMyQueues
methods.description: Returns the list of queues assigned to the current silo based on the balancing algorithm.

methods.name: GetActiveSilos
methods.description: Retrieves the list of active silo names excluding immature silos.

methods.name: GetBalancer
methods.description: Creates a new resource balancer based on the current deployment configuration and queue list.

methods.name: GetQueuesOfImmatureSilos
methods.description: Identifies queues associated with immature silos.

methods.name: OnClusterMembershipChange
methods.description: Handles changes in cluster membership by signaling cluster change.

methods.name: SignalClusterChange
methods.description: Notifies the system of cluster membership changes and updates silo states accordingly.
